overall: I managed to write the day, but on the phone I looked for a long time for where to start: the button hides in the menu, and the menu itself is tiny. On the computer a label ran over the button and I doubted I was pressing the right thing.

why.findability: On the phone an entry can only be started from the menu, which one would not guess.
why.tidiness: A label runs over the “New entry” button.

overlap:k3f9a2x7qd.why: In the close-up the label’s text lies over the button.

near-miss:b7c2d9e0wf.why: A pixel and a half does not show; the paragraphs look straight.

small-target:d4e5f6a7b8.why: The menu button is clearly smaller than a finger.

findings.where: The middle of the screen, the “New entry” button.
findings.text: The field label runs over the button; its letters lie on top of it.
findings.expected: The label above the button, with a gap.
findings.fix: Move the button below the label, or drop the label.

findings.text: The menu button is small; I hit it on the second try.
findings.expected: A button easy to hit with a finger.

findings.where: The dashboard on the phone: no “New entry” button on the screen.
findings.text: I could not find where to start the day’s entry until I opened the menu at random.
findings.expected: A “New entry” button right on the dashboard, as on the computer.
findings.fix: Show “New entry” on the dashboard on the phone too.

liked: The entry was saved at once, and it showed.
